verdict.rationale: Firebase documents an official Firebase MCP server that works with any MCP client, including Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot and Windsurf. A connected agent can create and manage projects, manage Auth users, and work with Firestore and SQL Connect data. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use, documented setup and authentication details for connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Firebase MCP server works with any tool that can act as an MCP client, including: Antigravity, Claude Code and Claude Desktop, Cline, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Windsurf, and more!

An editor configured to use the Firebase MCP server can use its AI capabilities to help you: Create and manage Firebase projects, Manage your Firebase Authentication users, Work with data in Cloud Firestore and Firebase SQL Connect
